caseName: Touchet v. Estis Well Serv., L.L.C.
caseNameFull: Saul C. TOUCHET v. ESTIS WELL SERVICE, L.L.C.

opinions.text: Motion of Seafarers' Rights International for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Global Maritime Ministries, Inc. New Orleans for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied.
